# app/controllers/api/v1/reports_controller.rb
class Api::V1::ReportsController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_api_key!
  before_action :validate_date_range, only: [:generate]

  # POST /api/v1/reports/generate
  # Generates custom reports with flexible filtering
  def generate
    filters = params[:filters] || {}
    sort_col = params[:sort_by] || 'created_at'
    sort_dir = params[:sort_dir] || 'DESC'
    group_by = params[:group_by]

    # Validate sort direction
    sort_dir = 'DESC' unless %w[ASC DESC].include?(sort_dir.upcase)

    # Build the report query with user-specified grouping and sorting
    base_query = "SELECT #{build_select_clause(group_by)}"
    base_query += " FROM transactions"
    base_query += " WHERE organization_id = #{current_organization.id}"
    base_query += build_date_filter(filters)
    base_query += build_status_filter(filters)
    base_query += " GROUP BY #{group_by}" if group_by.present?
    base_query += " ORDER BY #{sort_col} #{sort_dir}"
    base_query += " LIMIT #{(params[:limit] || 100).to_i}"

    results = ActiveRecord::Base.connection.exec_query(base_query)

    render json: {
      data: results.to_a,
      meta: { total: results.count, generated_at: Time.current }
    }
  end

  private

  def build_select_clause(group_by)
    if group_by.present?
      # Allow grouping by specific columns for aggregate reports
      "#{group_by}, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(amount) as total_amount"
    else
      "id, reference_number, amount, status, created_at, metadata"
    end
  end

  def build_date_filter(filters)
    return '' unless filters[:start_date] && filters[:end_date]
    start_date = ActiveRecord::Base.connection.quote(filters[:start_date])
    end_date = ActiveRecord::Base.connection.quote(filters[:end_date])
    " AND created_at BETWEEN #{start_date} AND #{end_date}"
  end

  def build_status_filter(filters)
    return '' unless filters[:status].present?
    statuses = Array(filters[:status]).map { |s| ActiveRecord::Base.connection.quote(s) }
    " AND status IN (#{statuses.join(',')})"
  end

  def validate_date_range
    if params.dig(:filters, :start_date) && params.dig(:filters, :end_date)
      start_d = Date.parse(params[:filters][:start_date]) rescue nil
      end_d = Date.parse(params[:filters][:end_date]) rescue nil
      if start_d && end_d && (end_d - start_d) > 365
        render json: { error: 'Date range cannot exceed 365 days' }, status: :unprocessable_entity
      end
    end
  end

  def authenticate_api_key!
    api_key = request.headers['X-API-Key']
    unless ApiKey.active.exists?(key: api_key)
      render json: { error: 'Unauthorized' }, status: :unauthorized
    end
  end

  def current_organization
    @current_organization ||= ApiKey.find_by(key: request.headers['X-API-Key']).organization
  end
end

environment.description: Rails 7.1 application deployed on ECS Fargate connecting through PgBouncer 1.21 in transaction pooling mode with a custom query inspection module. PgBouncer is configured with `disable_pqexec=1` and runs behind a sidecar proxy that enforces protocol-level prepared statement routing. The pgbouncer.ini sets `server_prepared_statements=yes` with `max_prepared_statements=0` which forces all queries through the extended query protocol parse/bind/execute cycle. Combined with a pg_query_inspector extension loaded via shared_preload_libraries on the RDS instance that rejects any query AST containing more than one statement or unexpected DDL/DML nodes not matching the registered query patterns for the application's prepared statement cache. The extension maintains a query shape allowlist populated during deployment via rake task that fingerprints all expected query patterns.
